instruction:
One-Storey L-Shaped Neighborhood Clinic Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad one-storey L-shaped neighborhood clinic model and save the required outputs to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 9 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 30 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 2 IfcRoof entities, and at least 1 IfcDoor entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: RECEPTION, WAITING, CONSULT-1, CONSULT-2, TREATMENT, STAFF, WC-ACC, CLEAN, and PLANT.
7. Each listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. Each listed space has a Reference property or LongName equal to its zone number: RECEPTION C01, WAITING C02, CONSULT-1 C03, CONSULT-2 C04, TREATMENT C05, STAFF C06, WC-ACC C07, CLEAN C08, and PLANT C09.
9. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are RECEPTION 12.0 m2, WAITING 12.0 m2, CONSULT-1 9.0 m2, CONSULT-2 9.0 m2, TREATMENT 15.0 m2, STAFF 9.0 m2, WC-ACC 4.0 m2, CLEAN 4.0 m2, and PLANT 6.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
10. The sum of all listed space areas is between 79.0 m2 and 81.0 m2.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area.
12. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 9 data rows in the same zone order and with the same zone numbers, names, and areas listed in the IFC pass conditions.
13. Each schedule Area value matches the corresponding IFC space area with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
